## Key terms

{{< glossary excel-table total-row sumif countif averageif summary-table pivottable row-field value-field data-insight check-ai-output >}}

## 25.1 Make the list a table

- **Home › Format as Table** (Ctrl + T), "My table has headers".
- A **name**, **filter buttons**, bands, a **total row**.
- New rows join the table.

![Format as Table.](images/format-table.png){width=100%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
No empty rows in the middle of the list.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Make the table"}
Make the March sales a table named `Sales` with a total row; save
`march.xlsx`.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Tables"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="File › Print|Insert › Picture"}
the shortcut for Format as Table
:   Ctrl + T

where you name the table
:   Table Design › Table Name

the total of Total (JD) in the total row
:   355

what stops the table early
:   an empty row
:::
:::

## 25.2 Summary formulas

- **SUMIF** adds, **COUNTIF** counts, **AVERAGEIF** averages the matching
  rows.
- **MAX** and **MIN**: the biggest and the smallest value.
- A **summary table**: one row per type.

![Summary formulas.](images/summary-formulas.png){width=100%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
"paper " with a space gives 0: copy the exact text.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · A summary table"}
Make a summary table: Paper, Drinks, Bags × Total, Count, Average.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Formulas"}
Choose the result for Rana's month.

::: {.match extra="24|0"}
=SUMIF(C2:C25,"Paper",E2:E25)
:   206

=COUNTIF(C2:C25,"Bags")
:   4

=AVERAGEIF(C2:C25,"Drinks",E2:E25)
:   7.1

=MAX(E2:E25)
:   60
:::
:::

## 25.3 PivotTables

- **Insert › PivotTable**; **Rows**: a field (Type, Week, Item).
- **Values**: Sum, Count or Average of Total.
- **Refresh** after the data changes.

![A PivotTable.](images/pivot.png){width=100%}

{{< sim file="sims/pivot-lab.html" poster="sims/pivot-lab.png" title="Pivot Lab: summarize Rana's month" height="600" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A PivotTable does not update by itself: Refresh.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Your PivotTable"}
Answer the four tasks in **Pivot Lab**; make a PivotTable by Week in
`march.xlsx`.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · PivotTables"}
Use Pivot Lab. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Bags|the second week"}
the type that sold the most
:   Paper

the best week
:   the third week

the biggest average sale by type
:   Paper (20.6 JD)

items sold four times
:   Juice, Notebook and Pen
:::
:::

## 25.4 AI help: summarize and check

- No personal data in the prompt; or AI in Excel with the university
  account.
- Ask for a summary **with numbers**.
- **Check** every number and trend with the PivotTable; keep the true
  **data insights**; say AI helped.

![An AI summary, checked.](images/ai-summary.png){width=100%}

{{< sim file="sims/summary-check.html" poster="sims/summary-check.png" title="Summary Check: is the AI right?" height="640" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A trend that sounds normal can still be wrong.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Ask and check"}
Mark the six sentences in **Summary Check**; then check an AI summary of
your own table.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Check the AI"}
Use Summary Check. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Bags sold the most|sales grew every week"}
"Total sales were 355 JD."
:   true

"The average sale was about 15 JD."
:   true

the type that really sold the most
:   Paper

the biggest single sale
:   60 JD (notebooks)
:::
:::

## Game challenge: The Right Tool {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Six questions: the **total of Paper**, the **biggest sale**, the **number of
Bags sales**, the **average Drinks sale**, **all weeks and types** at once,
and **three sentences** for the newsletter.

{{< sim file="sims/summary-tool.html" poster="sims/summary-tool.png" title="The Right Tool: six questions about the month" kind="game" height="460" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The tools"}
Choose the tool.

::: {.match extra="a pie chart|Ctrl + T"}
the total of Paper in one cell
:   SUMIF

the biggest single sale
:   MAX

every week and every type at once
:   a PivotTable

three sentences for the newsletter
:   an AI summary, then check it
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- Make the list an Excel table with a total row.
- SUMIF, COUNTIF, AVERAGEIF and MAX answer single questions.
- A PivotTable summarizes by any field in a few clicks.
- AI can draft a summary; check every number before you use it.
